body: This is annoying. Thanks for the report, I will have a look soon.
We are also seeing this issue in 3.8.5 and it produces a lot of unnecessary logs in our builds. Would be great if it gets fixed

issue.title: Fix issues in RegisterForReflection#registerFullHierarchy() handling
issue.body:
We were passing to ReflectiveHierarchyBuildItem and index that solely contained the annotated class so it was doomed to fail and output a lot of warnings.

Fixes a few other minor infelicities in passing.

Fixes #38486
